point_selection_basis: Matching sequence of distinctive shared administrative-boundary corners, with the reciprocal Gwanin/Gyeonghaeng labels on the two 1908 sheets
point_review_method: Manual visual review of original-image corner patches; approximate reading uncertainty ±3 pixels; role assignment frozen before fitting
threshold_purpose: Coarse image join screening; same pixel screening threshold as the prior review; not a metric accuracy criterion
limitations: Controls and checks lie on a shared boundary rather than throughout both map interiors.
The two maps may share survey lineage, so agreement is not independent historical corroboration.
This does not resolve the 1908-to-1912 correspondence or establish a geographic CRS.

result.interpretation: Shared-boundary pixel join supported by manual review; geographic accuracy and cross-year correspondence remain unverified.
